name: Native Root Interface Probe
description: Detects KernelSU, APatch, and native root frameworks by probing kernel prctl, supercall latency, cgroups, and driver file descriptors.

evidenceUnits.title: KernelSU and native root protocol response
evidenceUnits.observedObject: Kernel responses to root prctl commands, supercall latency, cgroup allocations, and driver file descriptors
evidenceUnits.proposition: The kernel interface or process environment returned a response satisfying a native root framework indicator
evidenceUnits.observationChannel: Direct native prctl, syscall latency benchmarking, /proc/self/cgroup, and /proc/self/fd
evidenceUnits.availability: Requires kernel interfaces and procfs nodes to execute without interception that suppresses or emulates responses
evidenceUnits.trustBoundary: The kernel syscall boundary is below ordinary Java mediation but can be modified by the kernel
evidenceUnits.inferenceLimit: The response identifies protocol compatibility or anomaly, not the full privilege granted to the app. The supercall latency deviation is a timing measurement taken without CPU pinning or frequency control, so it is treated as moderate corroboration rather than a direct marker.
